## Orientation

Orientation was interesting. It was good to learn more about the program, its structure, and deliverables. Long PowerPoints were as fun as long PowerPoints can be but they were important. Listening to the program's alumni was reassuring and fear-inducing at the same time (an interesting combination of emotions). It was really nice to meet my peers and start forming connections. 

## First Weeks

The first week of classes was nostalgic, having been three years since I had been to a lecture hall. Then came the workload. The sheer quantity of what we had to deliver each week felt overwhelming, even having been warned of it the week prior during orientation. However, those feelings quickly faded and I started to get into the rhythm of it.

## What Surprised Me

The emotional disparity between starting lectures at 0930 and 0800.
